SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT claim_payer_key) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied_claims, COUNT(DISTINCT claim_payer_key) AS remitted_claims
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE (is_current_adjudication)
)
SELECT denied_claims::DOUBLE / NULLIF(remitted_claims, 0) AS denial_rate, denied_claims, remitted_claims
FROM agg
LIMIT 100) AS compiled
